verdict.rationale: Apple documents Sidecar as a way to use an iPad as a second Mac display. It brings Apple Pencil to creative Mac apps such as Adobe InDesign, Affinity Photo 2 and ZBrush, and lets you keep the canvas on one display with tools and palettes on the other, which covers the designer story directly. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of Sidecar in creative workflows, and in-depth first-party setup and requirements documentation beyond marketing-page claims.
